notes.title: Senna and the Forest is going free!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone and happy new year!

After a lot of thought and deliberation I have decided to make all of my games including Senna and the Forest completely free.

It has been a tough couple of years for all of us, and for me specifically it meant giving up on professional indie-game development. This means there won't be any more updates to Senna and the Forest. 

However, I love this game and want as many people to enjoy it as possible. With that in mind I think it's best to make this game available for free. I have asked the folks at Valve to make this change on the 15th of February 2022.

Those of you have bought the game, I can't thank you enough for your support! 

Hope you have a great 2022!

Thank you.
Siddharth

notes.title: New Chapter - Gathering of flowers
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We've just added a new chapter that'll test Senna's logic and deduction skills further! The chapter is called 'Gathering of Flowers' where Senna encounters a garden whose flowers have wilted and lost their colour after the calamity.  Can Senna listen to the clues they provide and restore their colour?

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35490651/4ff007d798f8f7f27b009c69726745027a7c4a37.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35490651/4ff007d798f8f7f27b009c69726745027a7c4a37.gif[/img][/url]

As always do let us know in the forums if you encounter any difficulties playing the game!

Be nice to your neighbourhood trees! :)

notes.title: Kili's treasure - a new puzzle game from the creator of Senna and the forest
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I'd love to introduce you to Kili's treasure! This is a treasure-hunt style puzzle game, that  shares some similarities with Senna and the Forest.

You play a Kili a young girl who has just lost her dog and best friend Rosco. To cheer her up her mother has organized a treasure hunt with a surprise at the end. You interact with all the objects in the house and use that to solve a series of clues that lead to the treasure.

The game is currently out and can be found here.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1219020/Kilis_treasure/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1219020/Kilis_treasure/[/url]

If you liked Senna, you might want to check this game out as well! 
As always don't forget to be nice to your neighbourhood trees!

notes.title: Temple Of Lies
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
We're very happy to introduce you to the next chapter in Senna's journey called the Temple Of Lies. 

Senna enters an ancient abandoned temple for guidance. However to receive guidance he must first overcome a series of trials. He must look for sacred stones and activate them with runes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35490651/87fcea297808baccbe99f5d6d0dcb59869221471.gif[/img]

Once again the trees are always there to help him, but this time around not all of them can be counted upon. For some of the trees lie and deceive, and Senna must once again rely upon his powers of deduction to overcome the trials.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35490651/c901c0f4ef16a05f5de7b1b6b9daf1cea527cd09.gif[/img]

We hope you like the new chapter, and once again do let us know in the forums if you encounter any difficulties playing the game! 

Be nice to your neighbourhood trees! :)

notes.title: Mendel's Garden a new game in the Bhumi world is out!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We're happy to announce that our new game Mendel's Garden is now out on Early Access. Mendel's Garden is a gardening game inspired by Mendelian Genetics and is set in the same world as Senna and the Forest. 

The game features the adventures of Mendel a traveller from a far off kingdom who encounters a mysterious garden and its strange plants. Currently the first chapter which covers the first garden and its story is fully playable in the game. We're planning on adding a lot more content very soon including connections to Senna and his story!

You can take a look at the game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1132160/Mendels_Garden/]here[/url]!

We're also working on a new free content update to Senna and the Forest, and hope to have it ready next month. Until then we hope you take a look at Mendel's Garden, and don't forget to be nice to your neighbourhood trees!

notes.title: Blight forest update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We've just released a free content update to Senna and the Forest. A new chapter containing three levels, that feature a new twist to the original tree-investigation mechanic! Join Senna in investigating a forest crippled by the disease known as The Blight, that moves from one tree to the next. Talk to the trees, and use the clues they give to determine the order in which trees are attacked and understand the movement of the Blight. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35490651/3ef83372f14c09b12d5d99e8d5f60279501349b9.gif[/img]

Venture deeper and use the magical powers of old shrines to remove the Blight and cure the forest. The two chapters currently in the game can be played independently.

notes.title: Achievements update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We've added a minor update to the game in the form of an achievement. Now it's extremely easy to 100% the game, all you need to do is finish it! For those of you who've already finished the game, opening the game once should register the achievement and unlock it!

We're also working on a new area in the game which will feature a new mystery to uncover using the investigation mechanic, that we've all grown to know and (hopefully) love, but with a twist making it all the more interesting.

We'll have more news about the update soon! Until then happy playing, and don't forget to be nice to your neighbourhood trees! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Senna and the Forest is out!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Senna here!

I'm very excited to announce that the game Senna and the Forest is out! What's more, you can get the game at a 25% discount for the next seven days! This is an excellent time to get the game and join me on my journey through this mysterious forest!

I can't wait for you to play the game and hear what you have to say about my adventures!

- Senna
World famous explorer, friend of the trees and lover of exclamation points.

notes.title: Senna and the Forest Release Date!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone

I am Senna and welcome to my game!

Senna and the Forest releases on the [b]7th of August [/b] and I can't wait for you to join me on this adventure! 

But before you dive in let me give you a bit of history. This game is set in the beautiful yet dangerous world of Bhumi, where mankind's dominance over nature no longer exists. You see a long time ago....

Ah, the developers are asking me to wrap it up! 

Oh well, join me in the game and you'll understand everything about this world! Also if you haven't wishlisted the game now's a great time to do so! 

I think I'll take a nap now underneath this conveniently placed tree. But If you have any questions about the game don't hesitate to wake me up and ask!
